Hey, so I just got permanently banned. I knew it was coming, so I can't say I'm surprised it happened.

I think it was sometime around 2013 when GAF really changed, right after my account got approved. Before then, it was just a bunch of dedicated gamers talking about what they loved. People, the internet, was so much more level-headed back then, too. There were always two sides to a discussion. Whether you were liberal or conservative, your opinion counted, and you weren't shunned for thinking it.

I consider myself 100% moderate, something I was too scared to admit on NeoGAF. There are good ideas on both sides. Striking a balance between them is key. Both the left and the right have created bubbles for themselves, but they are very different imo.

The right has sort of taken this honesty approach, where there really are no limits on what they'll say. Kind of like extreme honesty or something. They'll say things no one else is willing to admit, and if you disagree, they'll at least allow you to speak up and defend your stance. I'm not saying that there aren't some absurd views on the right, but the left has equally as many.

Liberal communities on the internet have taken a much different approach to silencing dissenters. Rather than let you defend yourself, they'll literally remove you from the conversation. Words that don't really mean anything too specific like "problematic" get tossed around a lot to defend this. It's basically a dictatorship. People who drink the Kool-Aid don't get banned, and that just makes the hivemind stronger. Some of the best posters on the site have been banished for wrongthink; not even breaking any rules, just holding an opinion that isn't in line with the administrators'.

I ask, what kind of community do you want, NeoGAF? One where everyone thinks the same thing, and posters only comment to agree with the person above them? Posting on the internet doesn't resolve any of the issues you constantly whine about. At least differing opinions offer you the ability to learn and consider other points of view.

I sympathize with what this community's been doing on Voat. I've had my eye on it since it was on Reddit. Highlighting all the shady stuff that happens on the forum is a necessity. The words you use here aren't my favorite ones, but I'll defend your right to use them until I die. People who let words hold power over them are no better than those who use the words to hurt them.

That's all I really have to say. I know there are a lot of active GAFers who read these posts. Sucks that I have to say goodbye to a lot of the cool people I met over the years. It's still a cool place if you like to play video games. Just try not to get all your opinions from places that have the same viewpoint. You'll never grow as a person if you live like that.
